aiTexts: The TP-Link Tapo 360 WIFI 2K QHD AI Home Security IP Camera offers 1080P full HD video with a wide 360° horizontal and 114° vertical viewing angle for comprehensive monitoring.
Features include two-way audio for remote communication, advanced night vision up to 30 feet, motion detection, privacy mode, and audible-visual alarms to enhance security.
Supports local storage up to 128GB via microSD and cloud-based encrypted data storage for privacy protection.
Easy setup with just three steps via the Tapo App, compatible with Hey Google and Alexa.
Ideal for families needing remote monitoring, multi-camera management, and reliable long-term performance with a 3-year local warranty.

product.desc:
Tapo C211

Pan/Tilt Home Security Wi-Fi Camera

  • 2K 3MP High Definition: Capture every detail inside your home with crystal-clear 2K high definition video with this indoor security camera.
  • Up, Down, All Around: See everything across an entire room or walkway with the 360° horizontal and 114° vertical range pan/tilt field of view.
  • Detection & Instant Notification: Get instant push notifications when motion or a person is detected, subscribe to Tapo care to for baby crying detection. 
  • Night Vision up to 30 Ft.: Never miss a thing that goes on, even at night.
  • Precise Motion Tracking: Tracks and follows the subject to keep it within your view to keep an eye on the action.
  • 2-Way Audio: Enables real-time conversational communication through a built-in microphone and speaker. Never truly leave home with the built-in 2-way audio. 
  • Privacy Zone: Set customizable block zones to keep certain spaces from being recorded so you never need to worry about personal moments being leaked.
  • Device Sharing: View your Wi-Fi camera feed from two different smart phone devices. Now mom and dad can both see what's happening at home with a single camera.
  • Secure Local or Cloud Storage: Save footage continuously on up to a 512 GB microSD card† or subscribe to Tapo Care for cloud storage.
  • Voice Control: Works with the Google Assistant and Amazon Alexa to free up your hands.

aiTexts: The GXM P7 Dual Lens 2K Smart Camera delivers ultra-clear 4MP (2560×1440) resolution with two lenses for complete coverage.
The upper lens features 360° auto-tracking to follow moving subjects smoothly, while the lower lens offers a fixed wide-angle view to cover blind spots.
Equipped with AI human detection and facial recognition, it reduces false alerts and enables quick playback searches.
Night vision uses smart IR and full-color switching for clear images in darkness.
Supports dual-band WiFi (2.4GHz/5GHz) for stable streaming and two-way audio for real-time communication.
Storage options include MicroSD up to 256GB and optional cloud storage.
The ad-free app supports multi-device viewing for convenient remote monitoring.
